properties.smsText: BUS INDUSTRIAL ACTION may affect some services in Sydney’s Eastern Suburbs, Northern Beaches, Lower North Shore and Inner North-West.

current.urlText: BUS INDUSTRIAL ACTION may affect some services in Sydney’s Eastern Suburbs, Northern Beaches, Lower North Shore and Inner North-West.
current.content:
From Wednesday 4th November, some services may be affected by industrial action which involves drivers not operating certain vehicles.  
Buses may be delayed or cancelled and there may be longer wait times and crowding at major interchanges.  
Plan ahead, allow extra travel
current.subtitle: BUS INDUSTRIAL ACTION may affect some services in Sydney’s Eastern Suburbs, Northern Beaches, Lower North Shore and Inner North-West.

properties.speechText:
From Sunday 22 November, bus service changes including timetable and route changes and new routes will better connect communities with employment hubs, transport and essential services. They will also provide more frequent, reliable and sustainable transport options.
Read the news article at transportnsw.info for route-specific information and to learn more about the changes.
You can plan ahead using the Trip Planner from Sunday 8 November. Check signage at stops and allow extra time for your journeys during the service changes.
